responsibility: Specifies the lower-level channel-device linkage layer beneath IOChan. It defines opaque device identifiers, the DeviceTable structure full of operation hooks and per-channel metadata, procedures to allocate devices and channels, recover a device table from a ChanId, test device ownership, and raise standardized device exceptions, making it the contract that concrete device modules implement to integrate with the generic channel framework.
same_name_distinction: This .def file specifies the device-linkage interface beneath IOChan, including DeviceId, DeviceTable, hook procedure types, and channel/device management entry points, but not the registry and default-hook implementation provided by IOLink.mod.
